subject: Pendidikan Seni Visual
source: Pend Seni Visual T4 n T5.pdf
edition: Terbitan 2018, Bahagian Pembangunan Kurikulum KPM, September 2018 (KSSM Pendidikan Seni Visual Tingkatan 4 dan 5)
structureNote: Hierarchy: Bidang (Sejarah dan Apresiasi Seni Visual, Seni Halus, Reka Bentuk, Seni Kraf, Komunikasi Visual) > Tajuk (topic = unit; T4: 9 topics, T5: 8 topics, each numbered 1.0..n.0 within its form, so always key by level + code) > four Standard Kandungan per topic with FIXED pattern n.1 Persepsi Seni, n.2 Eksplorasi Seni, n.3 Ekspresi Seni, n.4 Apresiasi Seni > Standard Pembelajaran (n.m.k). Each topic has ONE Standard Prestasi table (Tahap Penguasaan 1-6) and a list of objectives (Objektif) and minimum hours. Minimum hours: T4 64, T5 54. Practical / art-making subject; only the Persepsi Seni (knowledge: history, definitions, types, tools, concepts) and Apresiasi Seni (explaining artworks using Bahasa Seni Visual / Pemikiran Seni Visual) parts are plausible for written questions. Printed numbering quirks kept as printed: T5 topic 1.0 SK 1.2 has only SP 1.2.2 (no 1.2.1) and T5 topic 2.0 SK 2.1 has only SP 2.1.2 (no 2.1.1). The Catatan column (Cadangan Aktiviti / Nota with examples) is deliberately not extracted. A Glosari (T4 and T5 term lists, DSKP pp.104-114) exists in the PDF and is not extracted.

units.title: ALAT KEBESARAN DAN PERHIASAN DIRAJA
objektif: (i) Menjelaskan jenis alat kebesaran dan perhiasan Diraja.
(ii) Memerihalkan fungsi, peranan alat kebesaran dan perhiasan Diraja.
(iii) Menghasilkan model alat kebesaran dan perhiasan Diraja.
(iv) Mempamerkan model alat kebesaran dan perhiasan Diraja dan menjelaskan pengalaman sendiri dengan menumpukan aspek Bahasa Seni Visual dan Pemikiran Seni Visual.

tahapPenguasaan.descriptor: Mengenal pasti alat kebesaran dan perhiasan diraja dalam bidang Sejarah dan Apresiasi Seni Visual.
